budget.declared: 2026-10-28, before any FDTD field was compared with a BEM reference
budget.metric: complex relative L2 = ||p_fdtd - p_bem|| / ||p_bem|| over receivers; exp(+iwt), free field exp(-ikr)/r; no gain, phase or normalization fitting

references.canopy: wave-review-2026-10-27 evidence, canopy/reference/reference-0.25-125.npz (1,166 receivers, 293 shadow by the independent segment/box check)

budget.reportedField: finest grid level (0.05/3 m), raw; no Richardson extrapolation in the headline

frequencySensitivity.note: FDTD (1.67 cm) evaluated off 125 Hz; diagnostic of resonance sensitivity, not a fit.

throughput.scope: GPU-busy time of paced runs (pacing sleeps excluded), all cells incl. CPML and solids; includes source injection, 1,166-receiver recording and plane DFT.

model.note: complex error at D wavelengths ~ |exp(-i a D/ppw^2)(1 - b/ppw^2) - 1|; direction-averaged over the fixtures, 7-point Yee scheme at Courant 0.99/sqrt(3)

projection.note: GPU-busy minutes per source run; multiply by 5 for 20% work pacing. Predicted errors are free-field dispersion only, at 10 wavelengths and across the 17.5 m scene diagonal; geometry and boundary errors add to them.
